title: Find x from a sum-and-difference pair
source: Theory IGCSE-14.1 Quick check 1 (x+y=10, x-y=4 gives x=7); book elimination style pp.431-435, new numbers
stem: Solve the simultaneous equations \(x+y={s|int}\) and \(x-y={d|int}\). What is the value of \(x\)?

steps.name: A
steps.note: x is half the sum of the two right-hand sides.

title: Find y by subtracting two linear equations
source: Theory IGCSE-14.1 Quick check 2 (2x+y=11, x+y=7 gives y=3); book substitution/elimination style, new numbers
stem: Solve the simultaneous equations \(2x+y={R1|int}\) and \(x+y={R2|int}\). What is the value of \(y\)?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: Subtracting the second equation from the first gives \(x={p|int}\). Then \({p|int}+y={R2|int}\), so \(y={q|int}\).
steps.note: (2x+y)-(x+y)=x. Last step is the y-value asked for.

title: Find x by adding to eliminate y
source: Theory IGCSE-14.1 Quick check 3 (4x+y=14, 2x-y=4 gives x=3); book elimination style, new numbers
stem: Solve the simultaneous equations \(4x+y={R1|int}\) and \(2x-y={R2|int}\). What is the value of \(x\)?

title: Solve a pair of linear simultaneous equations

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2020), Question 10(b) only. Official answers and mark allocation from the MS PDF. Part (a) is single-equation solving and is omitted. The item is paper/self-mark.

stem:
This question is 0580/32/M/J/20 Question 10(b), taken from the official QP.

Solve the simultaneous equations.
You must show all your working.

\(5x-2y=44\)
\(2x+3y=10\)

steps.name: M1
steps.text_tex: Multiply the first equation by \(3\) and the second by \(2\): \(15x-6y=132\) and \(4x+6y=20\).
steps.note: MS: M1 for equating coefficients of one variable by multiplying the equations by scalars, e.g. 15x-6y=132 and 4x+6y=20. Substitution is also accepted: M1 for rearranging one equation to make either x or y the subject.

steps.name: M2
steps.note: MS: M1 for adding or subtracting to eliminate one variable, e.g. 19x=152. If substitution is used, M1 for substituting the rearranged equation into the other equation.

steps.name: A2
steps.note: MS: A1 for y=-2. If 0 scored, SC1 for two values that satisfy one equation or SC1 for two correct answers without any correct working. Independent check: 5*8-2*(-2)=40+4=44 and 2*8+3*(-2)=16-6=10.
